diagnostics.message: The EKS cluster can be created with encryption enabled before the cluster role's cluster-encryption policy attachment is applied. The role must have the required KMS permissions before EKS provisions the cluster; add an explicit ordering dependency.

The EKS managed node group uses an IAM role whose required worker-node policies are attached by this resource, but the node group has no dependency on the attachment. The launch-template dependency only orders this when a custom launch template is actually used; with `use_custom_launch_template = false`, the node group can be created before its role permissions are ready. Add an explicit dependency so EKS node-group creation and deletion are ordered around the policy attachment.

The aws-auth ConfigMap is managed through the Kubernetes API but has no dependency on the EKS cluster. When no node-group module references contribute an indirect edge, Terraform may attempt to manage the ConfigMap before the cluster/API exists; order it after the cluster.

The Fargate profile can be created before the Fargate pod execution role's required managed policy is attached. The profile may become usable and start pods before that permission is available; order profile creation after the policy attachment.
